caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench or worktable with four sturdy legs, rendered in brown tones. On the left side of the table, there is a piece of leather placed flatly on the surface. The table has a central open compartment with divided sections, and within one of these sections is a wooden shoe last, which is an object used in shoemaking. Beneath the tabletop on the right side, there is a rectangular drawer that is partially open and is fitted with two round knobs. The wood grain and knots are visible across the surface of the table, the drawer, and the legs, suggesting a roughly finished wooden texture. The background is plain and uncolored, providing no additional context or objects.
title: Shoemaker's Bench
